name: eagle-demi-secret-sync
description: Copies mapped Key Vault secrets into OpenShift Secrets and restarts what reads them
_comment_main: This file is the PACKAGE MANIFEST OF THE ZIP, not of this directory: the deploy step copies it to the zip root, where the repo's own layout (src/secret-sync, src/utils) is preserved so the relative requires still resolve. Hence the path-from-repo-root main.
